brief:
An Israeli strike killed at least six people in Gaza City, Al Jazeera English reported. The strike occurred as ceasefire negotiations between Israeli and Palestinian officials remain stalled, with international mediators struggling to bridge gaps over the terms of a potential agreement to end hostilities.

The incident marks another escalation in violence amid the protracted impasse in talks. No immediate details emerged regarding the specific location targeted in Gaza City, the time of the strike, or whether civilian or military infrastructure was hit. International pressure to revive negotiations has intensified as violence continues unabated.
dek: The strike comes as efforts to push an agreement aimed at ending hostilities remain stalled.
title: Israeli strike kills at least six in Gaza City
